source_preview:
Disaster Recovery Coordinator
Disaster Recovery co-ordinator
Experience- 2 to 4 yrs
Location- Mumbai
Disaster Recovery Manager: Responsible for the overall DR program, including
planning, testing and implementation.
Skills & Experience:
* Technical Expertise: Understanding of IT infrastructure, including servers, databases,
network & virtualization
technologies like VMWare. Diagnosing and resolving hardware, software and network
issues related to Windows operating system.
* Servers & Application Onboarding: Provisioning new servers, installing & configuring
software, setting up new servers for applications deployments and providing ongoing
support.
* Problem solving - Ability to analyse problems, identify solutions and implement them
effectively. Providing technical assistance on Windows-related problems, networks,
firewall,
etc.
* Disaster Recovery Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of disaster recovery principles,
strategies and best practices. Ability to manage projects, timeline and resources
effectively
* Communication & collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to
work with diverse team and stakeholders
* Documentation and reporting: Ability to create clear and concise documentation and
reports
